context.problem_summary: The user is deciding whether to prioritize immediate or higher financial compensation over job quality, satisfaction, or career alignment.
context.primary_goal: Achieve an optimal balance between financial security and career fulfillment.
constraints: Immediate financial obligations and living expenses
Limited context on specific job offers or dollar amounts
Potential trade-offs between work-life balance and higher compensation
key_factors: Job culture, growth potential, and satisfaction
Current personal financial health and urgency

scenarios.title: Immediate Capital Accumulation Strategy
scenarios.description: Focus entirely on securing the highest immediate compensation package to fulfill immediate financial obligations and build a emergency reserve. Job quality and cultural fit are temporarily deprioritized with a strict 18-to-24-month exit plan.
key_actions: Accept the highest-paying position available regardless of culture fit
Implement a strict savings plan to clear debt or build capital rapidly
Set firm exit triggers and track key timeline milestones
resources_required: Family consensus on temporary work-life trade-offs

scenarios.title: Value-Aligned Mid-Tier Growth
scenarios.description: Accept a position offering moderate baseline salary with strong work-life balance and culture fit, while negotiating performance bonuses. This provides steady financial stability and family quality of time while steadily advancing core skills.
key_actions: Negotiate performance-based bonuses and remote flexibility
Build specialized, high-demand skills during regular work hours
Maintain steady upward progression without acute burnout

scenarios.title: High-Upside Aggressive Leap
scenarios.description: Pivot into a demanding, high-earning role with significant variable compensation, equity upside, or commission. This path trades immediate work-life balance for maximum earnings acceleration and rapid long-term career positioning.
key_actions: Target high-growth sectors offering equity or commission structures
Invest heavily in high-value network expansion and certifications
Delegate household responsibilities using increased earnings

scenarios.title: Fulfillment-Centric Lean Strategy
scenarios.description: Prioritize high job satisfaction and optimal long-term strategic alignment while restructuring living costs to match modest immediate compensation. Build internal leverage within an ideal working culture to negotiate substantial long-term pay raises.
key_actions: Accept a deeply aligned position at a modest baseline pay rate
Downsize non-essential personal and household expenditures
Demonstrate critical value to negotiate equity or substantial raises over time

negative_impacts.impact: High exposure to occupational stress and burnout caused by poor cultural alignment.
Potential strain on family dynamics due to work-life balance sacrifices.

outcomes.long_term_outlook: A solid financial cushion is established, allowing a strategic exit into a more aligned role within two years.

outcomes.short_term_outlook: Stable cash flow combined with high daily well-being and strong family alignment.
outcomes.long_term_outlook: Consistent competency building and healthy work balance position the user for steady, durable lifetime progression.
